historical SOL paid receipt is inspected in the original namespace
historical SOL remaining entitlement uses current signer and original custody once
existing USDC commitment resolves original cycle without initializing successor accounts
historical USDC paid receipt is inspected in the original namespace
historical USDC remaining entitlement uses current signer and original custody once
existing Token2022 commitment resolves original cycle without initializing successor accounts
historical Token2022 paid receipt is inspected in the original namespace
historical Token2022 remaining entitlement uses current signer and original custody once
current-operator existing commitment still binds the caller plan for immediate payout use
current-operator cycle binding rejects a foreign account before claiming a commitment
fresh creation binds only an authenticated finalized current-operator cycle

unreserved legacy commitment owned by an outgoing authority cannot be silently migrated
known previous commitment without a saved cycle never falls into successor initialization
changed immutable commitment fields cannot reach namespace initialization or payout
owned vault/cycle/reserve seeds and current router cannot be substituted
